propositions: mkdir(ticket_dir) runs outside the write lock in _prepare_event, leaving a window where the directory exists before its first event file is written; interruption in this window creates orphaned empty directories flagged by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH

New staging.py module writes directory and first event together in a dot-prefixed temporary path, then publishes with a single atomic os.rename under the write lock, eliminating the intermediate state

batch_stage_and_commit and inbound_translate._write_event_file and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission all carry the same mkdir-then-first-file signature and are converted to use staged event promotion
Temporary staging paths named .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex> are invisible to fsck scanners by existing dot-prefix exclusion rule, requiring no scanner changes

Stale staging directories are reclaimed by bounded, best-effort sweep using process ownership stamps (host + pid-namespace + start time) to safely identify dead owners, without touching ticket directories or violating the 043f no-writer-cleanup boundary
